titles.title: Flowering Cactus

description: This artwork is on the back of *Maple Leaves*, 1925 (CR No. 500). In this semiabstract work, a bright red cactus flower springs from a red and purple plant. These forms contrast with a vibrant green and yellow shape in the background of the work.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
